title: stopped list
description: What servers stop answers with -o json: what stopping each server did, so a script learns per server whether it stopped or was already gone.

kind.description: Always StoppedList, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

data.description: One row per server that servers stop tried to stop.

addr.description: The server's address from its record, which names the server the row is about.

pid.description: The server's process from its record, the one servers stop signals.

stale.description: The server was already gone; only its record went, and nothing was signalled.

stopped.description: The server was signalled and stopped listening, and its record went. When neither this nor stale is set, the server was not stopped.
